messages:
Raj Patel: Heads up
bout next Tuesday's all-hands (10am PT). Were going short: 30 minutes. Drop 1-2 bullets if youd like to be slotted.

Raj Patel: Draft agenda:
• 4m - company snapshot + hiring pulse
• 6m - Dedicated launch callouts (product)
• 7m - runtime perf + cost wins (eng)
• 5m - customer highlight (CS)
• 8m - live Q&A (collected + live)

Emily Wong: Logistics: hybrid room B + Zoom. Live captions enabled. If you need translation captions DM me. :white_check_mark:

Marco Ruiz: I can show a 60s clip of the autoscaler behavior for Dedicated (will fit in the product segment).

Priya Singh: Will this be recorded? I need to confirm a short thing before its public.

Clara Gomez: Recording is on by default. We'll post full recording and a 2-3min highlight clip in #all-hands-posts. Flag any segments for hold before EOD Mon and well remove.

Dave Li: Engineering request: include one slide with peak perf numbers and a one-line rollback plan for oncall folks.

Raj Patel: Good call. Dave + Marco please collaborate on that single slide (chart + one rollback line).

Marco Ruiz: Will drop a slide and demo link into the shared drive by Mon COB.

Emily Wong: Reminder: add any slides to the folder https://drive.reddoc/teams/allhands/briefs - one page per talk preferred.

Priya Singh: Also: will the exec update include policy changes? We need to know if comms should prep teams.

Raj Patel: No major policy rollout. Well call out a small tweak to deployment review process and link to the draft. If its approved, comms will follow next week.

Clara Gomez: For Q&A collection, use this short form: https://forms.reddoc/allhands-questions. Top items by Mon 5pm.

All-Hands Bot: Reminder set - "All-Hands: Tue 10am PT" will post 24 hours and 1 hour before.

Dave Li: I'll put the rollback line on the slide.

Marco Ruiz: Slide + demo clip uploaded by Mon evening.

Raj Patel: Thanks everyone. Keep requests tight. See you Tuesday. :rocket:
